title: 2.1 Duplicate Rejection Gateway
objective: Click node 50 to test duplicate rejection, click parent 20 to insert 25, then click new node 25!
controls: Click node 50 -> Click parent 20 -> Click inserted node 25
start_status: Step 1/3: Click node 50 to test duplicate rejection!
hints: A BST rejects duplicates: try to insert a key that already exists - the root is a good test.
A new key goes left if smaller, right if larger. Walk down from the root to find the parent it attaches under.
The inserted key is a brand new leaf. Click it to verify.
